events.name: St. Louis Blues at Winnipeg Jets

headlines.description: — Haydn Fleury scored his first goal in more than two years and added an assist, Kyle Connor and Mark Scheifele each had their 31st goal and the Winnipeg Jets edged the St. Louis Blues 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Haydn Fleury ends 2-year goal drought as the Jets edge the Blues 3-2

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Drake Batherson scored twice, including the eventual game winner, as the Ottawa Senators beat the San Jose Sharks 7-4 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Batherson's 2 goals help the Senators to a 7-4 win over the Sharks

headlines.description: — Cutter Gauthier scored with 2:30 left, Leo Carlsson had two goals and an assist and the Anaheim Ducks beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-3 on Sunday night to regain the Pacific Division lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cutter Gauthier breaks late tie in the Ducks' 4-3 victory over the Canadiens

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Minnesota Wild

headlines.description: — Bo Groulx scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs held on for a 4-2 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Groulx scores twice as Maple Leafs hold on and beat the Wild 4-2

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid had three assists, linemate Leon Draisaitl scored, but was injured soon after and the Edmonton Oilers beat the Nashville Predators 3-1 on Sunday to end a two-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid has 3 assists, Draisaitl injured in the Oilers' 3-1 win over the Predators

headlines.description: — Bobby McMann had a power-play goal and added an assist in his second game for Seattle, and the Kraken beat the Florida Panthers 6-2 on Sunday night to move into the second wild-card spot in the West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kraken beat the Panthers 6-2 to move into the 2nd wild-card spot in the West
